top_issues: Legend colors (On-chain/Reserve/Secured/Promised) all use near-identical green swatches; the promised bar is violet but three legend dots are indistinguishable greens — 'Promised $147.99' reads as secured money to a novice.
The absolute-scale bar under $187.99 is unexplained on this screen; without the Settings scale note, bar lengths look arbitrary.
'Show 1 empty' in the BALANCES row is a truncated/ambiguous action next to 'Add money' and 'Move'.
fixes: Give each money tier a distinct hue (green=on-chain, teal=reserve, amber=collateral, violet=promised) and use the same hue in legend dots, bars and hub cards.
Add a one-line caption under the hero bar: 'bars drawn at one absolute scale — 1px = $10'.
Replace 'Show 1 empty' with 'Show empty lanes' full label or an icon toggle.

top_issues: H1 account card: 'send up to 180.00' vs 'receive up to 23.00' lack $/USDC unit and any explanation of what limits them (credit line vs collateral).
Recent list mixes filled/placed/settled with no way to see route or fee from the row; 'Swap filled 03:57:03' shows no amount.
Two-segment bar under H1 has a floating tick marker whose meaning is never stated.
fixes: Append units to capacity labels ('send up to 180.00 USDC') and make them tappable to a credit/collateral explainer.
Add amount to the 'Swap filled' row and show fee on the 'Swap placed' row.
Label the bar tick ('credit line') or remove it.

top_issues: Route selector chips (You→H1→H2) and the '2 ROUTES' list duplicate the same information directly above each other — the card is nearly twice as tall as needed.
'Your account with H1 120.00' does not clarify whether 120 is what you hold or what H1 owes you.
Fee '0.000050 USDC' precision implies exactness with no rounding note, while swap screen shows 'lot rounding'.
fixes: Collapse the selected route into the summary rows and keep only the alternative route in the list.
Rewrite as 'H1 owes you 120.00 USDC' with the tier-colored bar.
Show fee as '≤0.00005 USDC' or add the same lot-rounding line as Swap.

top_issues: Address shown under 'To H2' is a long raw hex string with no copy/verify affordance visible — risky for a payment target.
CTA 'Pay 25.00 USDC' overlaps a partially scrolled route card; bottom edge collision looks like a rendering bug.
'Up to 180.00 instantly' is violet-accented but never explains it depends on the H1 account.
fixes: Add copy/EIP-681 QR icon and an address-book checkmark next to the resolved name 'H2'.
Reserve safe-area height so the CTA never overlaps card content (padding-bottom ≥ 96px).
Make 'Up to 180.00 instantly' a link that scrolls to the account/limits card.

top_issues: 'Settled 03:57:12 in 9s' — the 'in 9s' green suffix reads like a countdown, not elapsed time.
Proof hash is truncated with no tap-to-expand or explorer link.
Behind the sheet, the dimmed H1 card shows different numbers (+95.00) than the pre-pay screen (+120.00) with no delta callout.
fixes: Render as 'Settled in 9s · 03:57:12' so the duration precedes the clock time.
Make the proof hash tappable: expand full hash + copy + 'view on explorer'.
Add a one-line delta ('H1 balance +95.00, −25.00 paid') on the receipt.

top_issues: 'Verified by your runtime' is good, but there is no link from this trust claim to the underlying frame/proof detail.
Three near-equal buttons (Copy receipt / Download / Done) give no visual hierarchy for the primary next step.
Updated total ($162.99) behind the sheet is faint; user cannot confirm the new balance without dismissing.
fixes: Make 'Verified by your runtime' tappable, opening the frame #751 detail.
Emphasize 'Done' (already accent) and reduce the other two to text buttons in one row.
Show the new total inside the receipt footer ('New total $162.99').

top_issues: 'Prepare incoming account · H1 · Testnet' jargon block sits between amount and note, breaking the simple receive flow Maya needs; 'Capacity is checked for this account' is developer language.
'YOUR ENTITY ID' section exposes a raw 42-hex id with prose 'Anyone with an account route to you…' — deep protocol detail at the bottom of a consumer screen.
No visible QR or link summary in this scroll position; the primary share artifact is off-screen.
fixes: Move 'Prepare incoming account' behind an 'Advanced' disclosure; keep Amount → Note → Share as the visible spine.
Replace the entity-id prose block with a compact copyable id chip plus one short line.
Pin a mini QR + link preview above the Share card.

top_issues: QR occupies huge space but has no amount overlay — the payer cannot confirm the requested amount from the QR itself at a glance.
'Amount · optional 0.00' is confusing: 0.00 looks like a requested zero amount; placeholder should be empty.
'48.00 capacity via H1' label is unexplained inbound-capacity jargon.
fixes: Overlay the requested amount + currency + recipient name under the QR inside the white card.
Show placeholder 'Enter amount (optional)' instead of 0.00.
Rewrite as 'You can receive up to 48.00 USDC instantly via H1' with an info tap.

top_issues: Order book depth bars all reach nearly identical widths — they appear decorative, not proportional to size.
CTA 'Swap USDC for WETH' appears dimmed/disabled at the bottom with no reason shown in view.
Tap-to-fill hint ('1 tick = 1/10,000 USDC') is small gray text at the bottom; easy to miss.
fixes: Scale depth bars to the max level width (min 8%, max 100%) so differences are visible.
Keep the CTA enabled whenever a quote exists; dim only with an inline reason.
Move the tap-a-level hint to the book header row.

top_issues: Critical layout collision: the collateral slider and 'Swap USDC for WETH' CTA overlap inside the 'Prepare to receive' card — two interactive elements occupy the same pixels.
'100% collateral ↔ 0% collateral' slider with credit/collateral trade-off is the hardest concept on the screen and gets no explanation, only three preset chips cut off at the fold.
'You receive 0.039992' quoted amount is gray while the pay amount is white; receive leg deserves equal weight.
fixes: Fix z-layout: CTA must be a fixed footer below the card; slider full-width above it.
Add one sentence under the slider: 'More collateral = enforceable on-chain even if H1 vanishes.'
Render receive amount in white with a '$≈99.98' equivalent.

top_issues: WETH lane '+0.01 they owe you' vs 'Your credit line to them 0.01' — direction of the credit line relative to balance is genuinely confusing without a diagram.
'Frames signed 13' is protocol internals; a user cannot act on it.
Footer explanation ('Every frame here is signed by both of you…') is excellent but only appears at the very bottom of a long scroll.
fixes: Add a two-party mini-diagram (You ⇄ H1) with arrows colored by who owes whom.
Move 'Frames signed' to Ledger detail; keep only actionable rows in the card.
Surface the signed-by-both sentence directly under the account header.

top_issues: Legend row (secured/promised/you owe/credit room/in flight) is five small chips of tiny text — dense for mobile and 'in flight' hatched swatch is nearly invisible.
Dispute button sits in the action grid without any state (no 'nothing to dispute' or risk indicator) — dead affordance.
'Their credit line to you 0.00' immediately next to '+95.00 they owe you' reads contradictory at a glance.
fixes: Wrap legend to two labeled rows with larger swatches; increase hatch contrast for 'in flight'.
Show dispute risk state ('H1 responsive · 1d reply') instead of a bare Dispute tile.
Rename rows to 'Credit they give you' / 'Credit you give them' and tie colors to the legend.

top_issues: Only 4 movements and the page is ~70% empty black — wasted canvas; no date grouping beyond 'TODAY', no summary.
Filter chips truncate ('Accou…') with no horizontal scroll affordance.
'Swap filled' row has no amount or direction; inconsistent with other rows that show signed amounts.
fixes: Add a compact period summary (in/out/fees today) above the list to use the empty space.
Add edge-fade + scroll hint on the filter chip row, or wrap to two lines.
Show filled amount and received token on swap rows.

top_issues: Proof and 'To' hashes truncated with no tap/copy affordance visible in the sheet.
'Frames: 2 committed entries' is opaque — what the user can verify is behind a count.
No share/forward button on the receipt sheet despite the forward-a-receipt persona task.
fixes: Make hashes tappable with copy/full-view.
Link '2 committed entries' to the frame list view.
Add a 'Share receipt' action beside Copy/Download.

top_issues: 'Reveal recovery phrase' as a single tap button with no biometric/re-auth step shown — security-maximalist red flag.
'AT THIS SCALE' card explains the bar-scale gimmick with 'px' units ($100 = 10px) — developer mental model leaking into a consumer settings page.
'Forget vault' destructive action sits directly beneath the recovery actions with only color to separate it.
fixes: Require FaceID/passcode before revealing the phrase; show a hold-to-reveal pattern.
Translate the scale card to money language ('$100 renders this wide at the current scale') with a live sample bar.
Move 'Forget vault' to its own danger section with a confirm dialog.

top_issues: 'Dollars per pixel' slider is a novel but niche control given top billing above security and network settings.
Toggle descriptions ('Slow, fully yours' / 'Enforceable on-chain, funds collateral') are good but tiny; risk-relevant toggles lack warnings.
'Layout on wide screens' with '⌘K to jump' is desktop advice rendered on a phone screen — inconsistent responsive copy.
fixes: Demote the scale control into Appearance; lead Settings with Security/Recovery.
Increase description size to body-small ≥13px and add warning tint when turning Accounts off hides balances.
Conditionally hide ⌘K copy on touch devices.

top_issues: 'Add to batch' floats alone with no visible batch list or count — orphaned affordance.
'WHAT HAPPENS: Fund you through H1' radio appears unselected/ambiguous; the single consequence should be a statement, not a radio.
'Sign & send' for a Reserve→Account move promises on-chain posting but no gas/fee estimate is shown anywhere.
fixes: Show a batch summary chip ('1 move · 25.00 USDC') or hide batching until >1 item.
Replace the radio with a static consequence line with tier-colored icons.
Add a fee/gas line ('~$0.02 gas, paid from Reserve') above the CTA.

top_issues: From/To card triplicates full descriptions ('On-chain, in your signer') in all six tiles — heavy scanning cost; only balances differ.
CTA overlaps the 'WHAT HAPPENS' card at the fold, same layout collision as Pay.
Same-asset From and To both selectable (Wallet→Wallet) with no inline validation shown.
fixes: Compress tiles to name + balance + mini bar; move descriptions to a single legend line.
Fix CTA safe-area collision.
Disable invalid From/To combinations with a one-line reason.

top_issues: 'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' is the best trust summary in the product but sits below the navigation grid; Tomaszs/Ravis need it first.
Nav tiles mix user intents (Sovereignty=risk, Move=action, Assets=location, Lending=earn, Ownership=governance) in one grid — unclear grouping.
Violet '$122.99' promised figure is the risk exposure yet is styled same-weight as totals.
fixes: Promote the money-stands card above the tile grid.
Group tiles: 'Move money' (Move, Assets) vs 'Safety & control' (Sovereignty, Ownership) vs 'Earn' (Lending).
Give the promised figure an amber/violet warning tint with risk caption.

top_issues: 'Receive USDC from H1' primary CTA is disabled with the explanation card cut off above — cause and fix are split across the fold.
Collateral slider duplicated from Swap with the same 100/50/0 chips truncated; heavy jargon ('submits no collateral request').
Four stacked similar buttons (Receive / on-chain wallet / Gas / reserve) blur which is the faucet action.
fixes: Keep the disabled CTA's reason ('need 52.00 more collateral') visible adjacent to the button.
Deduplicate: reuse one collateral-selector component with a shared explainer.
Group faucet buttons under a labeled 'Get test funds' section.

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' allowance line repeated on every token with zero value — noise; only meaningful when non-zero.
'Move into reserve' button is cut by the card edge and half its label is clipped.
Signer/Depository contract addresses shown raw with no copy or explorer link.
fixes: Collapse allowance rows to a single 'Allowances: none' summary when all zero.
Fix 'Move into reserve' button overflow.
Make addresses tappable with copy + explorer.

top_issues: H1 POOL all zeros with an enabled-looking 'Offer to the pool' dimmed CTA — the economics (APY, who borrows, risk) are nowhere.
'Interest you ask · basis points 100' — bps input is trader jargon for a consumer lending screen, though the '= 1.00% per term' helper helps.
'Your offer sits in the hub pool until borrowed' — no counterparty/collateral risk disclosure for a locked principal product.
fixes: Show projected return ('25.00 → 25.25 after 1 day') and pool utilization before the CTA.
Default to percent input with bps in fine print.
Add a risk line: what happens if the hub defaults (collateral? dispute?).

top_issues: Hub/token/term selectors each consume a full card with large tiles — three screens of selection before any economic info.
No market rates shown: user sets 'interest you ask' blind (is 100 bps/day competitive?).
'H1 · 3 lanes' in the hub tile is unexplained internal vocabulary.
fixes: Compact selectors into single rows with chevrons; lead with rates and projected return.
Show pool's recent cleared rates as a suggested range.
Drop '3 lanes' or explain it on tap.

top_issues: 'Kind: Lazy (hash of its board)' — the word 'Lazy' as a kind label is confusing jargon; the paragraph explains it but only after the label.
Long explanatory paragraphs (board rotation, EntityProvider) are valuable for Kenji but unstructured walls of text.
Empty 'TAKE CONTROL OF ANOTHER ENTITY' state takes a full card for a rare case.
fixes: Rename kind to 'Single key (derived from board)' with 'Lazy' as technical sublabel.
Break paragraphs into titled bullets (Key rotation / Recovery / On-chain publication).
Collapse the takeover card to a single line with a chevron.

top_issues: 'Can dispute without asking 1 of 1' phrasing is cryptic; the count format (1 of 1) for a single entity is noise.
'signed just now' relative time next to absolute frame #770 mixes temporal references.
Evidence bundle explanation is strong but the 'challenge window' for a dispute is not visible anywhere on the screen.
fixes: Rewrite as 'You can open a dispute yourself — no hub approval needed.'
Use absolute time with relative in parentheses consistently product-wide.
Add per-counterparty row showing reply window ('H1 must answer within 1d').

top_issues: The green-vs-violet trust paragraph is the product's core differentiator and is excellent — but buried mid-scroll under the hero number.
'Enforceable right now $40.00' contradicts Home's hero ($162.99 total) without an explicit relationship line.
Promised $122.99 (maximum loss if hubs vanish) is shown after the safe tiers; risk should be equally prominent.
fixes: Move the green/violet legend paragraph directly under the hero number, before KEYS.
Add subtitle under hero: 'of $162.99 total; $122.99 is promised by hubs'.
Give 'Promised' its own amber-toned row with 'most you can lose' label.

overall.verdict: A coherent, genuinely differentiated wallet whose absolute-scale bars, receipts with proofs, and green/violet enforceability framing are real trust innovations — but the product consistently leaks protocol vocabulary (entity id, lanes, frames, collateral sliders, px scale) and suffers repeated CTA/overlap layout collisions on mobile. Novices get a workable Pay/Receive spine; anyone needing risk, lending economics, or dispute workflows must decode developer language to finish.
priority_fixes: Fix the fixed-CTA layout collisions on 02-pay, 05-swap and 10-move (button overlapping card content) — a shipping blocker on the money paths.

Adopt one tier-color system (green=on-chain/reserve, teal=collateral, violet=promised, amber=you-owe) across legend dots, bars, account cards and 'Where your money stands', ending the all-green legend ambiguity on Home.

Rewrite jargon into outcome language product-wide: 'capacity via H1' → 'receive up to X instantly', 'basis points' → percent, 'Lazy (hash of its board)' → plain kind names, '1 of 1' counters → plain statements.
Make all hashes, proofs and frame counts tappable (copy / expand / explorer) and add a Share/forward action to the receipt sheet.
Add economics and risk context where it is missing: swap collateral-slider explanation, lending pool rates and default risk, dispute challenge windows on Sovereignty.

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: Paying $20 worked end-to-end with a receipt, but words like 'capacity', 'entity id' and a 'Promised' balance she can't lose-but-might would worry her.
blockers: Receive screen jargon blocks (Prepare incoming account, entity id)
Home legend shows three identical green dots for different money types

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: Credit vs collateral is actually explained (colors, 'send up to/receive up to'), and the hub card is close to a Lightning-style capacity view.
blockers: No single risk dashboard showing collateral ratio per hub at a glance
Dispute/challenge window not visible on the account screen

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: A real order book with spread, depth and tap-to-fill is a strong swap experience; the broken collateral-slider/CTA overlap undermines confidence.
blockers: 05-swap layout collision over the slider
No fills history detail or price chart; depth bars not proportional

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: Export CSV plus receipts with frame numbers, proofs and 'Verified by your runtime' gives him board-ready evidence.
blockers: No signed PDF/formal attestation export, only CSV and receipt copy
Sovereignty vs total relationship requires mental math across screens

personas.name: Sofia
personas.verdict: Receive link with prefilled amount and instant settlement receipt covers her flow, but the receive screen buries it under protocol cards.
blockers: 04-receive: share flow below 'Prepare incoming account' and entity-id jargon
No invoice concept: no client name, label or recurring request

personas.name: Kenji
personas.verdict: Evidence bundle, co-signed frame counts, dispute entry and 'what is enforceable on-chain' are exactly his language — rare and good.
blockers: Reveal recovery phrase without visible re-auth step (09-settings)
Dispute flow itself (watching the challenge window) is not shown in the set

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: Pay is 3 taps and the receipt confirms in 9s, but several screens have overlapping CTAs and long scrolls that hurt one-handed speed.
blockers: CTA overlap/collision on 02-pay, 05-swap, 10-move
Swap requires scrolling past collateral controls to confirm

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: The hub card with credit lines, collateral and send/receive capacity is close to a desk view, but it is per-hub only and mobile-dense.
blockers: No aggregated Desk/table of all counterparties and exposure in the mobile set
Legend swatches for in-flight/credit room nearly invisible

personas.name: Fatima
personas.verdict: The 'Across networks' swap tab and multi-hub route list (You→H1→H3→H2) promise her exact flow, but fees per hop and the cross-network screen are not shown.
blockers: Cross-network variant screen missing from the set
Per-hop fees not broken out in the route list

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: The green/violet 'enforceable right now' framing plus signed-frame receipts communicate the differentiator in under a minute.
blockers: Hero total vs enforceable number inconsistency across Home and Sovereignty needs one sentence
Jargon leakage (lazy entity, lanes, px scale) weakens the premium first impression
